newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Lee slams century as New South Wales reach 225.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Lee slams century as New South Wales reach 225.

text.p: Shane Lee hit a whirlwind century before New South Wales declared their second innings closed at 225 for three to set Tasmania a target of 302 to win their Sheffield Shield match on Monday.

All-rounder Lee flayed the Tasmania attack for an unbeaten 101 after New South Wales resumed at 70 for two on the final day. Kevin Roberts added 54 before he was caught and bowled by Tasmania captain David Boon.
